description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

description.zh:
阿里云资源的标识。
> 您可以通过此参数确认该资源所属的账号、服务、地域等。目前只能给Top Level资源的服务进行标签的相关操作。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

>  You can use the value of this parameter to query information about the resource, such as the account, service, and region of the resource. You can manage tags only for services for top level resources.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open get-resource-tags --resource-arn acs:fc:cn-shanghai:1880770869020000:services/demo --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id my-test-trace-id --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
